summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching an English translation of a September 11, 2026 letter to the Argentine Securities Exchange Commission (CNV), its US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report. The letter reports notification of a Federal Court of Appeals of Tucuman ruling in Asociacion de Consumidores del NOA v. Telecom Personal S.A., docket 15065/2016. The appellate court confirmed rejection of compensatory liability for the March 3, 2015 service outage but reversed solely to require proportional reimbursement of the price for service not provided. No transaction, securities offering, or special-situation terms are stated.
